name: code/tui-app
title: Terminal app
summary: Terminal app in Python with curses: list and detail panes, live filter, sort, help, colour that falls back to monochrome, tests for its logic.
when: Use when the user wants an interactive terminal app to browse notes, tasks or any list of records, or names curses, a TUI or ncurses.

title.about: The app title, in the header line and the help panel.

accent.about: curses colour for the selection and headings: teal, cyan, blue, green, magenta, red or yellow.

items.about: What the records are, plural (tasks, notes), for the labels and the empty message.

next: Write the files, run python3 -m pytest -q, then python3 app.py. Adapt items.json to the user's records (title, status, tags, date, body); for other fields, rename them in load_items, detail_lines and sort_items in app.py.
